**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 of the Brightline agreement lands at our preferred position on every material term of the ASSIGN rule:

- **24.1** — Customer may assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets **without Vendor consent** (prompt notice plus assignee assumption only).
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), and never to a direct Customer competitor.
- **24.3** — Other assignments are subject to a mutual reasonable-consent standard.
- **24.4** — Our change of control gives Vendor **no** right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees or reduce service, and Vendor must cooperate with successor administrative changes.

Cross-checks confirmed no conflicting language: the only other "change of control" references are within § 24, and § 13 (p0056) is consistent, letting us transfer licence rights to an Affiliate or successor under a Section 24 assignment. Neither walk-away trigger (blanket Customer assignment ban without an M&A carve-out, or a Vendor change-of-control termination/re-pricing right) appears.
